children: Loop Industries amended the condition precedent to CEO Daniel Solomita’s resignation, lowering the required ATM offering proceeds to $4 million.
The amended condition requires an at-the-market common stock offering generating at least $4 million in gross proceeds before fees and commissions.
The new threshold replaces the prior $6 million minimum; the amendment no longer specifies the previous $0.20 minimum share price.
The sunset date remains November 27, 2026, unless Solomita agrees in writing to a later date.
The company cautioned that the condition may not be met and the contemplated leadership transition may not occur.

title: Loop Industries Lowers ATM Proceeds Threshold Tied to CEO Resignation
